reading.title: Listening without assumptions
reading.text: At a community group, people may share a change or simply listen. Leila discusses getting married, having a baby, and a career change. Sami talks about retirement and traveling abroad. He also describes loss and grief after a friend’s death. The group discusses a funeral and the meaning of divorce without asking for private details. Amal explains an illness, a bicycle accident, and a neighbor moving away. Other members mention a layoff, a breakup, and recovery after illness.
